items.title: Fix Scope-type divergence in db migrations (Role.scopes: db Scope entity vs @n8n/permissions Scope)
items.notes: Surfaced during A8b build. src/migrations/common/1742918400000-AddScopesColumnToApiKeys.ts(32): getApiKeyScopesForRole (public-api-permissions.ts) wants role: Pick<RoleObject,'scopes'> where scopes is @n8n/permissions string-union Scope[]; but GLOBAL_ROLES is Record<GlobalRole, db-entity Role> whose scopes are db entities/scope.ts Scope OBJECTS ({slug,displayName,description}). LIKELY FIX (verify): pass getApiKeyScopesForRole({ role: { scopes: dbRole.scopes.map(s => s.slug) } }). Clean-room, minimal. NOT part of A8b.
